purpose: PR59 isolate cold-OEM-mirror preparation recovery and transient ownership fallback. Reversible source-only change before PR58,57,55,54 and frozen tests; no task/surface/VD/input mutation.

patches.before:
* OEM failure or a >28ms mirror setup disables trials until SystemUI restart;
 * ordinary task movement and the PR53 low-cost cue continue normally.
patches.after:
* A single cold 28ms GPU mirror miss may recover on the next tap; repeated
 * slow attempts or a severe delay disable the private native path for safety.
 * Clear OEM denial still disables for the SystemUI session. The PR53 fallback
 * remains available when live mirroring cannot be used.

patches.before:
private const val PREP_BUDGET_MS=28L
    private const val VISUAL_LEAD_IN=0.90f
patches.after:
private const val PREP_BUDGET_MS=28L
    private const val SEVERE_PREP_MS=80L
    private const val VISUAL_LEAD_IN=0.90f

patches.before:
NeXtepLog.warn("native_swap", "PR55 fallback: GPU mirror unavailable reason=$reason")
            StageConcurrentNativeTrialPolicy.disableForSession("OEM mirror unavailable: "+reason)
            return false

NeXtepLog.warn("native_swap","Mirror preparation exceeded frame budget: $setupMs ms")
            return false
patches.after:
NeXtepLog.warn("native_swap","Mirror preparation exceeded frame budget: $setupMs ms; native allowed next tap=" +
                StageConcurrentNativeTrialPolicy.allowed(true,true,false))
            return false
